sections.heading: Changed
items: Packaging only — no user-visible change.

sections.heading: Changed
items: The window title now shows your licence state next to the app name and version: a star and Pro when Pro is active, and Pro inactive when a Pro licence has lapsed or could not be checked. It updates as soon as the licence changes, so you can see your status without opening the Pro window.

sections.heading: Changed
items: One licence number for every Mayorana app on this computer. Paste it in any of them and the others are Pro too the next time they start, with nothing to paste again; a number already pasted in one app is shared the same way. Removing the licence in the Pro window removes it from all of them.

sections.heading: Added
items: Free AI credits every month, without Pro. Enter your email under Get free AI credits in the Pro window and the licence number arrives by email; paste it in the same window. The window then shows how many credits are left this month. The free version's limits stay as they are.

sections.heading: Changed
items: SpreadRadar Pro now comes with a monthly plan on mayorana.ch instead of a one-time licence key. Paste the licence number from the plan's email (like ABCDE-FGHJK-LMNPQ-RSTUV) in the Pro window. SpreadRadar checks it when it starts and once a day, and Pro keeps working for a week without a connection.
The Pro window shows your plan, the AI credits left this month and when the plan renews. Manage subscription opens the page where you change or cancel it.

sections.heading: Added
items: A Feedback button next to MCP opens the contact form with SpreadRadar and your version already filled in, so an idea or a problem reaches us in two clicks.

sections.heading: Changed
items: SpreadRadar now includes the necessary Windows C runtime libraries, ensuring it runs on any PC without requiring additional installations. This makes the app more portable and easier to use for new users.

sections.heading: Added
items: Use SpreadRadar from Claude. The new **MCP** button next to Get Pro… shows what to paste into Claude Desktop, or the one line to run for Claude Code, already pointing at where SpreadRadar is installed. Claude can then read your watchlist's prices and best edges, look at one asset venue by venue (routes before and after fees, which venue lags), list what Gate and MEXC just listed that Binance doesn't have, and add or remove assets. An asset Claude adds or removes shows up in the open app within a couple of seconds. Trading stays in the app.

sections.heading: Added
items: The New listings tab now shows each token's best edge between exchanges: buy on one, sell on another, after the taker fee on both legs. **By edge** puts the ones worth a look first, and the Detections log notes when an edge of 30 bps or more opens or closes. Exchanges with under $10k of volume are left out, since their best price is often a stale order.

An edge that needs Gate is marked when Gate has closed deposits or withdrawals for the coin, so you don't chase a gap you can't move coins across. The other exchanges don't publish this, so check them yourself.

Gaps over 20 % are marked "same token?": they almost always mean two different tokens sharing a ticker. Prices come from the scan every 5 minutes; click **Watch** to follow a token's edge live on the Market tab.

sections.heading: Added
items: Light mode. SpreadRadar now matches your computer's light or dark setting and follows it when it changes. The sun/moon button at the top right switches between the two.

sections.heading: Fixed
items: On Windows and Linux, the SpreadRadar window now shows its icon in the title bar, the taskbar and the app switcher, instead of a blank or generic one.

sections.heading: Changed
items: Spreadwatch is now called SpreadRadar. Your Pro licence, hot wallet, watchlist and settings carry over: they stay in the same folder, `~/.config/spreadwatch` (`%LOCALAPPDATA%\Spreadwatch` on Windows). On macOS the update installs as SpreadRadar.app; once it runs, you can delete Spreadwatch.app from Applications.

sections.heading: Added
items: SpreadRadar Pro. The free version follows 3 assets at once, with every tab, every venue and trading; Pro follows any number, and is the licence for commercial use. Buy it on [SpreadRadar's page](https://mayorana.ch/en/apps/spreadradar), then click **Get Pro…** at the right of the tab bar and paste the key. The key is checked on your computer: no account, nothing sent anywhere.

If your watchlist already holds more than 3 assets, none is removed: the first 3 are followed and the others stay in the list marked 🔒 Pro. Remove one to make room, then click a locked one to follow it.

sections.heading: Changed
items: The publisher information for SpreadRadar has been updated to 'Mayorana'. This change affects the metadata associated with the application, such as the installer and executable details.

sections.heading: Added
items: SpreadRadar now shares anonymous usage statistics: whether it is installed and opened, its version and your operating system. It is on by default; a note at the bottom of the window tells you once, and nothing is sent before you have seen it. **Turn off** there stops it for good and deletes anything not yet sent. Your files, data and accounts are never part of it. It also stays off if `DO_NOT_TRACK`, `DISABLE_UPDATE_CHECK` or `MAYORANA_NO_TELEMETRY` is set.

sections.heading: Changed
items: Packaging only — no user-visible change.

sections.heading: Added
items: The version you are running now shows at the right end of the tab bar, so it is at hand when you report a problem or check whether an update installed.

sections.heading: Changed
items: Packaging only — no user-visible change.

sections.heading: Added
items: First public release, for macOS (Apple Silicon and Intel), Windows and Linux.

Follow any asset by ticker and see it quoted against USDT on Binance, Bybit, OKX, MEXC and Gate, plus Jupiter for Solana tokens, with the best cross-venue edges net of fees and which venue's price trails the others.
A New listings tab: tokens Gate or MEXC just listed that Binance spot does not, scored by volume, other listings, market cap and Binance's interest.
SOL/USDT swaps through Jupiter from a hot wallet the app creates, with a dry run at every start and hard per-trade and daily limits.
The app tells you when a newer version is available, with a link to it.

sections.heading: Changed
items: The app was called SOL Spread. Its settings folder, with your hot wallet, watchlist and `trade.toml`, moves from `~/.config/sol-spread` to `~/.config/spreadwatch` the first time you start it; nothing to do by hand. A `keypair_path` in `trade.toml` that still points into the old folder keeps working, and the trade panel asks you to update it.
